title: Chapter 10. THE BRAIDED MAN OF PYRAMID MOUNTAIN
chineseTitle: 第10章. 布发男子 Pyramid Mountain

paragraphs.en: The cone-shaped mountain towered into the clouds. Directly ahead was an arched opening leading to broad, spiraling stairs cut into the rock. At the base, a sign warned: "WARNING.
paragraphs.zh: 金字塔山上的圆锥形山峰直插云霄。正前方是一个拱门，通向一条盘旋而上的石阶。在山脚处，一块告示牌上写着：“警告。”

paragraphs.en: These steps lead to the Land of the Gargoyles. DANGER! KEEP OUT."
paragraphs.zh: 这些台阶通向石像鬼之国。危险！禁止入内。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy pondered how Jim would draw the buggy up so many stairs. The horse snorted disdainfully and declared it wouldn't be difficult, but insisted everyone walk.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西思索着吉姆如何将马车拉上这么多台阶。那匹马不屑地哼了一声，声称这并不难，并坚持让大家步行上去。

paragraphs.en: Zeb suggested the stairs might get steeper. "Then you'll have to boost the buggy-wheels," Jim replied nonchalantly.
paragraphs.zh: 杰布建议阶梯可能会变得更陡峭。“那你们就得给马车轮子加点力了，”吉姆不以为意地回答道。

paragraphs.en: They began their ascent with Dorothy and the Wizard leading, followed by Jim pulling the buggy, and Zeb watching the harness.
paragraphs.zh: 他们由多萝西和巫师带头攀登，吉姆拉着马车紧跟其后，扎比则仔细检查着缰绳。

paragraphs.en: The light was dim, and soon they entered total darkness. The Wizard lit his lanterns, allowing them to proceed steadily until they reached a landing where light and air filtered in through a rift in the mountain side. From there, they could see the Valley of Voe far below, with cottages appearing like toy houses.
paragraphs.zh: 灯光昏暗，很快他们便陷入了完全的黑暗。巫师点亮了他的灯笼，让他们得以稳步前行，直到到达一处平台，在那里山壁上的裂缝中透进了光线和空气。从这里向下望去，可以看到下方的沃谷，一排排小屋仿佛玩具房屋般微小。

paragraphs.en: After resting briefly, they resumed their climb. The stairs remained broad enough for Jim to easily pull the buggy. The old horse panted and stopped often to catch his breath, but everyone was glad to wait as continual climbing made legs ache.
paragraphs.zh: 休息了一会儿后，他们继续攀登。楼梯宽绰，吉姆轻松地拉着马车前行。老马喘着气，经常停下歇息，但大家都不急着催促，因为不断上升的海拔让每个人的腿都感到酸痛。

paragraphs.en: They wound upward, the lights from the lanterns dimly guiding them through a gloomy journey. A broad streak of light ahead assured them they were nearing another landing. Here, one side of the mountain had a large hole like a cavern's mouth, and the stairs continued up at the opposite edge.
paragraphs.zh: 他们沿着蜿蜒的路径向上攀爬，灯笼微弱的光芒为他们的阴暗旅程指引方向。前方一道宽阔的光带让他们知道即将到达另一个平台。这里，山的一侧有一个像洞穴口的大洞，而阶梯则在对面边缘继续向上延伸。

paragraphs.en: The travelers looked out from the mountain opening opposite the Valley of Voe and saw a strange scene. Below them was a vast space with a black sea of waves and flames. Above them, banks of shifting clouds in blues and greys revealed delicate fairy forms.
paragraphs.zh: 旅者们从对面山谷——沃谷的山口望出去，眼前出现了一幅奇异的景象。下方是一片广阔的空地，仿佛有一片黑色的波涛和火焰在翻滚；上方则是变幻莫测的蓝灰色云层中隐约现出仙灵般的身影。

paragraphs.en: "Are they real?" asked Zeb in awe.
paragraphs.zh: “它们是真的吗？”佐比惊叹道。

paragraphs.en: "They are Cloud Fairies," replied Dorothy softly.
paragraphs.zh: “他们是云仙子，”多萝西轻声说道。

paragraphs.en: Zeb observed the clouds closely. "They look like open-work. If I squeezed one, there wouldn't be anything left."
paragraphs.zh: 扎比仔细观察着云朵。“这些云像镂空的图案一样。如果我挤一挤，里面什么都没有。”

paragraphs.en: Occasionally, large birds flew swiftly between the clouds and the sea below. They resembled the rocs from Arabian Nights with fierce eyes and sharp talons.
paragraphs.zh: 偶尔，几只大鸟在云层与下方的海面之间迅速飞过。它们的眼睛锐利凶悍，爪子尖锐锋利，颇似《天方夜谭》中的 Roc 鹰身兽。

paragraphs.en: "Look!" exclaimed the little Wizard. A man stood in the center of the cave floor, bowing politely when he noticed them.
paragraphs.zh: “看！”小巫师喊道。一个男人站在洞穴中央，注意到他们后礼貌地鞠了一躬。

paragraphs.en: He was an old man with long white hair and beard braided into many strands, each tied with a colored ribbon. "Where did you come from?" asked Dorothy wonderingly.
paragraphs.zh: 他是一位白发长髯的老者，胡须和头发编成了多股辫子，每根辫子上都系着彩色的丝带。“你从哪里来的？”多萝西好奇地问道。

paragraphs.en: "I came from no place recently," answered the braided man. "I lived on top of the earth but have had my factory here for years—halfway up Pyramid Mountain."
paragraphs.zh: “我最近并没有来自何方，”辫发男子回答说，“我曾居住在地面上，但我的工厂已经在这里经营多年了——位于金字塔山半山腰的位置。”

paragraphs.en: "Are we halfway up?" asked Zeb, sounding discouraged.
paragraphs.zh: “我们已经爬了一半了吗？”赛布问道，听起来有些沮丧。

paragraphs.en: "I believe so, lad," replied the braided man. "But I've never been in either direction since arriving, so I can't be sure if it's exactly halfway."
paragraphs.zh: “我相信是这样，小伙子，”辫发男子回答道，“但我自从来到这里后从未去过那个方向，所以不能确定它是否正好在中间。”

paragraphs.en: The wizard examined the braid-haired man from Pyramid Mountain closely. "Do you have a factory here?" he asked.
paragraphs.zh: 巫师仔细打量着金字塔山来的辫发男子，“你这里有个工厂吗？”他问道。

paragraphs.en: "Yes, of course," replied the man. "As an inventor, I produce my inventions in this remote location."
paragraphs.zh: “当然，没错，”那人回答，“作为一名发明家，我就是在这样一个偏远的地方制造我的发明。”
